title: Missing SPA Routing and Edge Security Headers on Cloudflare Pages
description: Cloudflare Pages static hosting requires an explicit _redirects rule for single-page applications and a _headers file to inject modern defensive HTTP headers at the edge.
root_cause: Prior to remediation, web/public contained no _redirects or _headers configuration, resulting in HTTP 404 errors on deep SPA routes and missing edge security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Content-Type-Options, etc.).
intended_behavior: Cloudflare Pages edge should rewrite all non-asset routes to /index.html with HTTP 200 and return strict edge security headers on all responses.

trace.description: Edge rewrite rule mapping all SPA paths to /index.html
Edge HTTP response header directives for security policies

evidence.description: Defines Strict-Transport-Security, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, X-Frame-Options, and Permissions-Policy

conditions.description: Frontend repository built and published to Cloudflare Pages

execution.attacker_perspective: Unauthenticated web visitor requesting deep URLs or inspecting response security headers
instructions: Request a deep client route on the static host
Inspect response HTTP headers for security protections and status code
execution.observed_result: Deep routes returned 404 and edge responses lacked modern hardening headers prior to adding _redirects and _headers

remediation.strategy: Deploy _redirects and _headers in web/public to instruct Cloudflare Pages edge router and inject security headers

code_changes.fixed_code:
/*
  X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff
  Referrer-Policy: no-referrer
  X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN
  Cross-Origin-Opener-Policy: same-origin
  Cross-Origin-Resource-Policy: same-origin
  Permissions-Policy: accelerometer=(), camera=(), clipboard-read=(), clipboard-write=(), geolocation=(), gyroscope=(), magnetometer=(), microphone=(), payment=(), usb=()
  X-Permitted-Cross-Domain-Policies: none
  Strict-Transport-Security: max-age=63072000; includeSubDomains

/index.html
  Cache-Control: no-cache

/assets/*
  Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable

likelihood.reason: Occurs whenever users directly open or bookmark deep SPA URLs on Cloudflare Pages

impact.reason: Degrades availability of deep routes and exposes the frontend to missing edge framing and MIME sniffing protections

confidence.reason: Cloudflare Pages documentation and deployment specifications confirm _redirects and _headers behavior

title: Reverse Proxy IP Resolution Ignored CF-Connecting-IP Behind Trusted Proxy
description: When deployed behind Cloudflare reverse proxy, the client IP resolution function _client_ip checked X-Forwarded-For but did not evaluate CF-Connecting-IP provided by Cloudflare edge.
root_cause: The _client_ip function in src/neuron_agent/api/main.py only inspected X-Forwarded-For entries when peeling proxy addresses, ignoring the canonical single client IP header provided by Cloudflare.
intended_behavior: When request.client is within APP_TRUSTED_PROXIES, the server should first evaluate CF-Connecting-IP for the authenticated edge client IP.

trace.description: Incoming HTTP request client address inspection
Verification of peer address against trusted proxy allowlist
Resolution and normalization of client IP for rate limiting key derivation

evidence.description: Added CF-Connecting-IP check when peer is trusted proxy
Unit tests verifying CF-Connecting-IP extraction behind trusted and untrusted peers

conditions.description: Backend API deployed behind Cloudflare reverse proxy with trusted_proxies configured

execution.attacker_perspective: Client sending requests through Cloudflare with custom X-Forwarded-For or relying on CF-Connecting-IP attribution
instructions: Send request with CF-Connecting-IP through a peer in trusted_proxies
execution.observed_result: Before remediation, CF-Connecting-IP was ignored in favor of X-Forwarded-For; after remediation, CF-Connecting-IP is prioritized for trusted peers

remediation.strategy: Inspect and parse CF-Connecting-IP when peer is a trusted proxy, mapping IPv6 to /64 CIDR

likelihood.reason: Requires Cloudflare reverse proxy deployment with multiple proxy headers present

impact.reason: Could lead to rate limit key misattribution or shared bucket collision between clients

confidence.reason: Verified through unit tests in test_rate_limit_keys.py

title: Direct Origin Exposure Bypass of Cloudflare Edge / WAF
description: The backend container exposes port 8000 directly. If the host network interface is reachable from the public internet without an ingress firewall, attackers could bypass Cloudflare WAF and DDoS mitigation by sending requests directly to the origin.
claimed_root_cause: Dockerfile and Uvicorn server bind to 0.0.0.0:8000 without requiring mutual TLS (Authenticated Origin Pulls) or restricting ingress to Cloudflare IP ranges / Cloudflare Tunnel.

trace.description: Receives raw TCP connections directly from any routable peer

blockers: Target repository does not contain cloud infrastructure manifests (Terraform, AWS Security Groups, or Kubernetes NetworkPolicies) establishing whether origin port 8000 is shielded from public internet ingress.

validation_plan.local: Run container locally and inspect network binding on loopback vs external interfaces.
validation_plan.deployment: Infrastructure operator verifies that origin firewall allows inbound traffic only from Cloudflare IP ranges or that cloudflared tunnel is used for origin ingress.

title: Unauthenticated Health Readiness Endpoint Exposes Deployment Environment Name
description: The /health/ready endpoint is unauthenticated and returns a JSON payload containing the environment name from settings.env (e.g. dev, staging, prod).
claimed_root_cause: In src/neuron_agent/api/main.py, the readiness healthcheck handler returns {'status': 'ready', 'environment': settings.env} without authentication or environment sanitization.

trace.description: JSON response construction returning environment string

blockers: Repository source does not indicate whether Cloudflare WAF Transform Rules or API Gateway rules filter or shield the /health/ready route from public callers.

validation_plan.local: Send GET /health/ready using httpx locally to observe response body.
validation_plan.deployment: Infrastructure operator verifies if Cloudflare WAF or reverse proxy restricts /health/* to internal monitoring tools.

title: Cloudflare Access JWT Assertion Header Integration
description: Cloudflare Zero Trust Access authenticates users at the edge and passes identity in the Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion HTTP header. The backend TokenVerifier currently inspects the standard Authorization: Bearer header.
claimed_root_cause: src/neuron_agent/security/auth.py verifies tokens from the Authorization header but does not natively extract tokens from Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion if Cloudflare Access is deployed.

trace.description: Header extraction from HTTP authorization request

evidence.description: TokenVerifier parses Authorization header with Bearer scheme

blockers: Deployment architecture does not define whether Cloudflare Access is utilized in front of the API or whether a Cloudflare Worker transforms Cf-Access-Jwt-Assertion into Authorization: Bearer.

validation_plan.local: Review TokenVerifier header extraction logic with test headers.
validation_plan.deployment: Zero Trust administrator confirms whether Cloudflare Access is attached to API endpoints and how the JWT assertion is forwarded.
